entities.name: Askaranton
entities.description: A former kingdom in the Domains of Dominaria, raided by Keld.

entities.name: Keldon warriors
entities.description: Warriors of Keld, some with Phyrexian genes from the Bloodline project, who skirmished in Askaranton.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Had sleeper agents in Askantaron reporting on the skirmish.

entities.name: Croag
entities.description: Phyrexian put on the trail of Gatha's meddling in Keld's bloodlines.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: Figure whose meddling in Keld's bloodlines drew Phyrexian ire.

entities.name: Bloodline project
entities.description: Project giving some Keldon warriors Phyrexian components in their genes.

events.summary: Phyrexian sleeper agents report a skirmish between locals and Keldon warriors, some with Phyrexian affinities.
events.quote: Phyrexian sleeper agents in Askantaron reported a skirmish between the locals and a large number of Keldon warriors

events.summary: After Keld's visit Askantaron is no longer a kingdom, and the Keldon army ships plunder back to Icehaven.
events.quote: After Keld's visit, Askantaron was no longer a kingdom

relations.note: Keld raided and ended the kingdom.
relations.quote: After Keld's visit, Askantaron was no longer a kingdom
